requirement: Add a dosage to an existing antibiotic: reject unknown or soft-deleted antibiotics, map the command, enforce exactly one standard dose per route, and reject overlapping CrCl ranges before persisting the dosage.

preconditions.text: Antibiotic exists and the requested route has no dosage yet
Antibiotic exists with one standard oral dose
Antibiotic exists with an IV standard dose and an inclusive CrCl range [30, 60]
Antibiotic ID is not present in the database

inputs.text: Standard dose for a new route of administration
Adjusted dose with CrCl (15, 29) for a route that already has a standard dose
Adjusted dose with CrCl (60, 90] when the existing range is [30, 60]
Command with an antibiotic ID that does not exist
Second standard dose for a route that already has one
Adjusted dose for a new route that has no standard dose
Adjusted dose with CrCl (45, 75] overlapping the existing range [30, 60]
Adjusted dose with CrCl [60, 90] touching the existing [30, 60] range at 60

returns.text: Success result with Created status and the new dosage ID
Failure result with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic not found' error
Failure result with BusinessRuleViolation and no persisted dosage

exception_text: No unhandled exception; validation failure is returned as a failed Result
